question: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q3 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)

calls.reasoning: Recent pattern: guide midpoint ≈ prior-quarter actual × 1.115-1.123 (Q2 guide 91 vs Q1 81.6; Q3 guide 108 vs Q2 96.2), and actuals beat guide ~5-6%. Q3 actual likely ~112.5-115B (Polymarket Q3 DC >105B at 55%, >110B at 28%, thin volume — near-miss contracts on Q3 DC revenue, not the Q4 guide; no market found on the guide itself). Applying ×1.10-1.13 gives ~124-130B; Yahoo consensus for Jan quarter ~$124.9B (range 117-138), and NVIDIA has been guiding above consensus. Governance turmoil (CEO board probe) is a stock risk, unlikely to change the demand-based guide; China still excluded. Median ~127B.
calls.dossier:
- Q1 FY27 (Apr 2026) revenue $81.6B (+20% q/q), DC $75.2B; Q2 FY27 outlook issued then: $91.0B ±2% (SEC 8-K / Kiplinger, May 2026).
- Q2 FY27 (Jul 2026) revenue $96.2B (beat $91B guide by ~5.7%), DC $89.0B (+18% q/q, +117% y/y) (SEC 8-K q2fy27pr, Aug 26 2026).
- Q3 FY27 outlook: $108.0B ±2%, no China DC compute assumed; GM 74.0% ±50bp (SEC 8-K, Aug 26 2026). Guide/prior-actual ratios: 91/81.6=1.115; 108/96.2=1.123.
- Q3 consensus revenue ~$108.8-109.0B (MarketPulse, Zacks via TradingView, Nov 2026).
- Yahoo Finance analyst avg for Jan-2027 quarter revenue ~$124.9B, low ~$117.3B, high ~$138.5B; next-quarter estimate revised up ~5.7% over 3 months (Yahoo/chartmill, Nov 2026). FY27 consensus ~$411.6B.
- Polymarket thin markets (hundreds of $ volume) on Q3 DC revenue thresholds $100B/$105B/$110B/$115B — these resolve on Q3 DC actual, not Q4 guide.
- CoreWeave Q3 (Nov 2026): revenue $3.66B +168% y/y, backlog $132.5B, demand ~10x capacity — demand signal (Investing.com, Nov 11 2026).
- Downside items: board investigation of CEO Jensen Huang (announced Nov 8), WSJ report board considering removal; Baird downgrade to Neutral; congressional briefing Nov 18; forward P/E ~11.4x (Investing.com/Invezz, Nov 11-12 2026). Margin concerns on packaging/memory costs (MarketPulse).
- CNBC Aug 26 2026: Huang forecast ~70% FY2028 revenue growth, above estimates.
- Status quo: NVIDIA issues a single-point ±2% revenue guide; it has excluded China DC compute for 3 consecutive quarters.
- Resolution: midpoint of Q4 FY27 revenue outlook in Q3 FY27 press release (Nov 17, 2026), rounded to nearest $1B; not the Q3 actual.
- Event window: release on 2026-11-17 -> single event; as of 2026-11-13 the release is ~4 days away.
- Searched but not found: whisper number for Q4 guide; any human market on the guide itself; Q1 FY27 guidance-vs-Q4 FY26 actual ratio.

calls.reasoning: Last four next-quarter guides were 1.115-1.145x the just-reported quarter (+$8.0, +9.9, +9.4, +11.8B steps). Beats vs guide midpoint have grown ($3.1B, $3.6B, $5.2B), so Q3 actual is likely $112-114B (thin Polymarket Q3 Data Center ladder implies ~$106B Data Center => ~$114B total). Applying 1.12-1.14 gives ~$125.5-130B; Street Q4 consensus $124.9B tends to lag the guide. Risks: memory supply limits, a cautious tone amid the CEO/board governance probe (could hold back the step-up), China excluded. Upside: fiscal 2028 ~70% growth guide and strong CoreWeave demand. No human market on the Q4 guide itself; Polymarket Q3 Data Center markets (thin, <$1k volume) used as evidence only.

calls.reasoning: Last four next-quarter guides were 1.115-1.145x the just-reported quarter. Beats vs guide have run $3-5B, so the Q3 actual is likely ~$112-115B (the thin Polymarket Q3 Data Center ladder implies ~$113-114B total). 113.5 x 1.12 gives ~127B, above the Street Jan-quarter consensus of ~124.9B, consistent with NVIDIA guiding above the Street. The CEO governance probe and memory supply limits add some low-tail risk; the Rubin ramp and 70% FY28 growth commentary support the upside.
calls.reconciliation: All three runs share the same anchor (guide is about 1.12x the prior actual) and the same Q3 beat logic; their medians of 126-127 differ only in the assumed Q3 actual and ratio. Factual dispute: Q3 consensus of 109B vs 111.4B could not be settled offline but moves the expected actual by only ~2B. I carry Run 2's ratio range with Run 1/3-like width, since the Q3 actual is still unknown. Judgment: the governance turmoil is treated as low-tail widening, not a median shift. No retrieval this run.
